summary.intent: Improve the memory-loop TUI injection tab to show all active memories with clear inject/skip status, then remove unused commands (skill, insights, improve, permissions) keeping only summary and memory-loop, then simplify/clean up the branch diff.
summary.outcome: All three goals achieved: injection tab now shows INJECT/SKIP labels with skip reasons via PreviewSelection; four commands and their package directories were deleted with shared helpers relocated to session_cache.go; simplification pass fixed truncate duplication, containsString, pushState copy-paste, unbounded History growth, and a Gemini pointer bug.

repo: PreviewSelection returns a SelectionReport with both Matches and Skipped (with reasons), while SelectRelevant only returns matches — use PreviewSelection when showing full injection status to users.
maxInjectionLogs = 50 cap already existed for injection logs; History on MemoryRecord had no equivalent cap and needed one (maxHistoryEvents = 100).
insights/, insightsdb/, improve/, and skillimprove/ are library packages still consumed by summary and memory-loop — they must not be deleted even when removing the CLI commands that expose them.
backfillSummaries and backfillFacets wrapper functions became dead code after commands were removed; only the ForRows variants were still called.
summarytui/root.go had nolint comments stripped by gofmt during mise run fmt — those changes should be reverted as unrelated before committing.
stringutil.TruncateRunes exists in the repo and is the correct UTF-8-safe truncation utility; the summarytui version was using a byte-unsafe hand-rolled version.
Gemini writeHookResponse used a value struct pattern while Claude Code and Codex used pointer pattern — mismatch caused spurious empty JSON fields in hook output.
pushState() method existed in memorylooptui/root.go but was not being called; three blocks copy-pasted its 4-line body instead.

code.finding: Now uses SelectionReport from PreviewSelection to render INJECT/SKIP labels with skip reasons instead of raw score numbers.
testPromptResultMsg changed to carry a full SelectionReport instead of just a slice of matches.

New file consolidating shared helpers: refreshCacheIfStale, metadataToSessionRow, extractToolCounts, backfillSummariesForRows, backfillFacetsForRows, sessionRowsToSummaries, renderUsageLine — relocated from deleted command files.
containsString hand-rolled helper replaced with slices.Contains from stdlib.
Added maxHistoryEvents = 100 const and trimming logic to cap unbounded History growth on MemoryRecord.
writeHookResponse fixed to use pointer struct pattern matching Claude Code and Codex lifecycle implementations.

workflow: When deleting CLI commands, verify which imported packages are libraries vs command-only before deleting — library packages used transitively must be kept.
mise run fmt can strip nolint comments from files not intended to be changed; always diff after fmt and revert unrelated file changes before committing.
Lint (unusedwrite) fires when test code sets struct fields that are never read — remove the assignments when calling methods directly on a sub-component.
Run git show HEAD:<path> to recover deleted file contents when grep finds nothing for a symbol in the working tree.

friction: ExitPlanMode was called twice in a row after user interruptions, causing minor confusion in plan flow.
session_cache.go initially failed compilation because it imported the deleted insights package for scoring — had to restore insights/ as a library package.
Two functions (sessionRowsToSummaries, renderUsageLine) used by memory_loop_cmd.go were defined in improve_cmd.go (not insights_cmd.go) and only discovered at compile time after deletion.
The Edit tool's old_string uniqueness requirement caused multiple sequential edits to session_cache.go when appending functions, requiring a Bash fallback to append content.
lint flagged unusedwrite on activeTab assignments in new tests because tests called tab view methods directly rather than going through the root model.
open_items: timeAgo duplication across packages — would require a new shared package, deferred as architectural change.
captureStdout test helper duplicated across 3 agent test packages — minor, test-only, not addressed.
writeHookResponse logic duplicated across 3 agent packages (geminicli, claudecode, codex) — needs agent refactor to unify.
Hot-path caching for maybeInjectMemoryLoop — performance optimization deferred.
N+1 patterns in refreshCacheIfStale — performance optimization deferred.
wrangler.search.jsonc (search worker) is NOT deployed by main CI and requires manual deploy — search routes 404 until manually deployed.
